CRAZY BRICK TAXI
GENÈVE

Pick up minifig passengers and race them across real-scale Geneva — every street, building and hill is where it really is.

Map © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL) · Elevation © swisstopo · Not affiliated with the LEGO Group or SEGA.

HOW TO PLAY

Drive

W/↑ accelerate · S/↓ brake / reverse
AD/←→ steer · Space handbrake drift
Shift boost · H horn · R back on the road
C camera · M map · P/Esc pause · N music · U mute · V passenger voices · Q graphics quality

Gamepad: RT gas, LT brake, stick steer, A drift, X boost, B horn, Y camera, Start pause.

Fares

Minifigs waving inside a coloured ring want a taxi. Stop in the ring to pick them up. Ring colour = trip length: red short · orange · yellow · green long.

Follow the big arrow to the landmark and stop in the green zone. Fast drop-offs earn bonus seconds. Drifts, jumps and near misses earn tips. Fares are paid in Swiss francs.

The 10 destinations sit at their real positions — Cornavin to the Broken Chair is really 1.4 km.
